name: manual_4b1472
claim: A published validation row must separate local results from CI and name the environment: say 'CI pending' until every check on the exact head is green, and state whether paired sibling checkouts were present. A local pass says nothing about CI cells whose environment differs, and a teammate's row is not a substitute for reading the failed CI log.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: Oramasys PR 68 remediation was reported as 272 passed locally; all six offline-oracles cells then failed the manifest result gate with 'N skipped exceeds the allowance'. It was found only by reading the CI log.
